title.zh: 查询频道在线用户列表
title.en: Query the List of Online Users in a Channel

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
本接口用于查询频道内在线用户列表，不包含用户详细信息。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes

This operation lists the users who are currently in a channel. The response does not include detailed user information.

# QPS limit

The rate limit for this operation is 1,000 calls per minute per user. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your service. Call this operation at a reasonable frequency. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~341645~~).
